candidates.name: Cogent Security, Inc.
candidates.vertical: V1 B2B SaaS — cybersecurity (AI vulnerability mgmt)
candidates.notes: Freshest money + an empty marketing org + a named GTM leader to report to. The textbook shape.

A_Q1.evidence: Head of Demand Generation req: 'lead all pipeline-generating functions across marketing, including digital, partner, and field, and sales development' … 'start building your team across field/channel and digital/content so Cogent can scale pipeline with far more leverage'

A_Q2Q6.evidence: 49 employees, enterprise-security buyer universe is large and enumerable (named CISO accounts); marketing org is being built from scratch under a Head of Growth

A_Q3.evidence: no founder/leader public complaint about outbound cost found in cheap discovery

A_Q4.evidence: 'Six months after launch, Cogent raises $42M led by Bain Capital Ventures to scale the first AI taskforce for vulnerability management.'

B_named_account.evidence: 'AI systems for enterprise cybersecurity teams' — enterprise CISO motion; role explicitly owns 'field' and 'partner' channels

B_acv.evidence: enterprise vulnerability-management platforms sell at six figures; role is a senior player-coach with an FY27 demand model

B_outbound_language.evidence: 'owns the front end of the revenue engine: creating, converting, and scaling qualified pipeline' + owns sales development

C_stage.evidence: Series A, $42M, Bain Capital Ventures + Greylock + Definition, announced 2026-02-18

C_headcount.evidence: 'Cogent employs 49 people, founded in 2024. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.'

C_mktteam.evidence: at 49 total headcount the marketing team is necessarily <10; the Head of Demand Gen is being hired to build it

D_no_abm_tool.evidence: no ABM/personalization platform named anywhere in the req's tool expectations or on the site

D_leader_or_reqs.evidence: Head of Growth already in seat (the req reports to them); Head of Demand Gen req published 2026-08-14

E_channel_fit.evidence: CISOs and security leaders are densely reachable on LinkedIn; a physical executive report on an org's own vulnerability posture is a natural direct-mail artifact

candidates.name: Harmonic Security, Inc.
candidates.hq: San Francisco, CA, USA (US + UK workforce; the ABM role is New York, NY - Remote)
candidates.notes: The purest possible Q1: they are hiring the exact role Clue replaces, at a modest salary band.

A_Q1.evidence: An open req titled 'Account-Based Marketing Manager, Strategic Accounts' — department 'Go to Market Corporate Marketing', $93K–$108K + equity + bonus. This is literally the seat Clue automates.

A_Q2Q6.evidence: 'Harmonic Security employs 56 people and has an annual revenue of $1M, founded in 2023' — a 56-person company opening a dedicated strategic-accounts ABM seat has far more target accounts than capacity

A_Q4.evidence: 'Harmonic Security Raises $17.5 Million Series A to Accelerate Zero-Touch Data Protection to Market' — market-expansion earmark, but Apr 2025 (>12 months old)

B_named_account.evidence: the req is scoped to 'Strategic Accounts'; 'Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface' — enterprise motion, backed by In-Q-Tel and Ten Eleven Ventures

B_acv.evidence: enterprise AI-governance platform sold to security teams; In-Q-Tel backing implies government/large-enterprise deals

B_outbound_language.evidence: a dedicated ABM function inside 'Go to Market Corporate Marketing' is by definition an account-based outbound motion

C_stage.evidence: 'Stage Series A | Alive · Total Raised $25.96M · Last Raised $17.5M'

C_mktteam.evidence: 56 total headcount ⇒ a marketing team in the low single digits

D_no_abm_tool.evidence: no ABM platform named in the req; a company hiring its FIRST ABM manager is unlikely to have an enterprise ABM platform installed

D_leader_or_reqs.evidence: the ABM req itself is the open GTM seat; timeline page shows continuous GTM build-out ('2026 • January — Upscaled Brand Launched')

D_recent_round.evidence: last confirmed round Apr 2025 — outside the 12-month window

E_channel_fit.evidence: CISO/security-leader audience is LinkedIn-dense; the $93–108K band signals a budget that a platform beats on cost

candidates.name: Vendelux
candidates.notes: Fresh $50M, four open GTM reqs, and a buyer persona identical to Clue's own. Hiring its way out of the bottleneck right now.

A_Q1.evidence: 'Outreach Campaign Operations Manager' (Customer Success, $80K–$120K) and 'Growth Marketing Lead' ($160K–$230K OTE, published 2026-04-16) — campaign assembly done by hand, but neither req is explicitly account-research-shaped

A_Q2Q6.evidence: their buyer universe (B2B companies that spend on events) is large and enumerable; they are staffing it with individual hires

A_Q4.evidence: 'Vendelux, a live events information platform, has raised $50 million to help marketers capitalize on that. Tribeca Venture Partners led the company's Series B raise' (2026-07-08)

B_named_account.evidence: sells a high-consideration platform to enterprise event/field-marketing orgs; hiring a Revenue Operations Lead ($150K–$185K) to industrialize the motion

B_acv.evidence: event-intelligence platforms sell to enterprise marketing budgets; $66.4M raised against a NYC cost base implies a mid-five-figure+ ACV

B_outbound_language.evidence: an entire req named 'Outreach Campaign Operations Manager' — outbound is a staffed function

C_stage.evidence: 'Founded Year 2021 · Stage Series B | Alive · Total Raised $66.4M · Last Raised $50M | 2 mos ago'

C_headcount.evidence: Series B, NYC, 4+ concurrent GTM reqs — headcount consistent with the 30–300 band

C_mktteam.evidence: hiring both a Growth Marketing Lead and a Product Marketing Lead ⇒ the marketing team today is small

D_leader_or_reqs.evidence: FOUR concurrent GTM/marketing reqs found on one board — Growth Marketing Lead, Product Marketing Lead, Revenue Operations Lead, Outreach Campaign Operations Manager. Q7 satisfied outright.

D_recent_round.evidence: $50M Series B, July 2026 — two months old

E_channel_fit.evidence: their buyers ARE B2B marketers — the most LinkedIn-native audience that exists — and an events company is structurally a high-touch, physical-artifact buyer (Q10 by definition)

candidates.name: Uptiq (UPTIQ, Inc.)
candidates.vertical: V3 fintech — AI agents for banks & credit unions
candidates.notes: The only candidate with PROVEN ABM spend (a $400K-pipeline agency case study). Buys the category already; the question is platform-vs-agency, not whether.

A_Q1.evidence: NOT FOUND — a targeted job-board search for Uptiq marketing/demand-gen reqs returned zero Uptiq postings (it surfaced Glia, MX, Alloy, Relay instead). Absence of evidence, recorded as such.

A_Q2Q6.evidence: '150+ Financial Institutions Trust Us' against a US universe of ~4,500 banks + ~4,600 credit unions — a finite, enumerable named-account market with ~3% penetration

A_Q4.evidence: 'Uptiq Raises $25 Million Series B to Scale Industry-Ready AI Solutions and Launch Qore for Builders' (DALLAS, 2026-02-13)

B_named_account.evidence: sells into named financial institutions ('TransPecos Banks' named as a customer); an ABM case study documents a named-account program

B_acv.evidence: 'over $10 billion in transactions processed' across 150+ FIs — core-banking-adjacent contracts, six figures

B_outbound_language.evidence: a published third-party case study titled 'Uptiq.ai ABM Case Study: $400K+ Pipeline' — they already run, and measure, an ABM motion

C_stage.evidence: 'Latest Deal Type Series B · Latest Deal Amount $25M · Employees 129 · Year Founded 2022'

C_mktteam.evidence: they outsourced their ABM engine to an agency (GrowthSpree) rather than staffing it — the clearest possible evidence the in-house team is small

D_no_abm_tool.evidence: an ABM AGENCY is engaged, but no ABM PLATFORM is detected — agency ≠ D3 disqualifier; it is a displaceable line item

D_leader_or_reqs.evidence: no open GTM req found and no recent GTM-leader hire confirmed

E_channel_fit.evidence: bank/credit-union executives are a conservative, senior, finite audience where physical mail materially outperforms email — Clue's most differentiated agent aimed at its best-fit audience

candidates.name: Oscilar
candidates.drop_reason: H2 AMBIGUOUS → excluded. Strongest non-selected candidate. Palo Alto CA (PASS H1), 150–200 employees (+130% YoY), open 'Outbound Marketing Manager' req at $155K–$184K (a Tier-1 Q1), sells to banks/fintechs (finite market). BUT: 'Oscilar is entirely self-funded, backed by $20 million that Narkhede and the company's other co-founder, Sachin Kulkarni, themselves contributed' (TechCrunch 2023-03-30) and a targeted 2024+ search found NO external priced round. CB Insights/aVenture label it 'Series A' on the strength of that self-funding. Under H2 as written ('a named priced round with a date and at least one named investor') it fails. Recorded as a rule blind-spot, not a judgement about the company.

fit_vs_intent_divergence: Deliberate: Zafran is #1 on fit and #4 on intent. Fit measures 'should they buy'; intent measures 'will they engage now'. The divergence is the falsifiable claim.
selection_honesty_note: Only 3 of 5 cleared the >=75 'select' band (81.0 / 80.0 / 79.5). Slots 4 and 5 are the top of the strong-bench band (67.5 / 66.5). The bar was NOT moved to manufacture five selections.
